## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Verification

List the focused and full checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Behavioral changes include focused tests.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] I considered the effect on authorization, workspace containment, cancellation, and process cleanup.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, sensitive project data, or local state are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior changes include appropriate documentation.
